Hi Elisa — thanks for the clear ask. Quick response with two pragmatic paths so procurement has clean choices. Im copying Ben (AE) and David (finance) to confirm pricing and Stephanie for any legal notes.

Option A — "Mezzanine Credit" (hybrid credit + conversion incentive)
- One-time top-up: 15,000 token credits (usable immediately for pilot).
- Price: $18,000 (one-off invoice).
- Conversion: any unused credits within 30 days may be applied as a $/token credit toward a future committed package; if converted within 60 days we can offer a conversion uplift (10% credit bonus).
- Legal: minimal amendment; no changes to core T&Cs, add one short SOW addendum (attached).

Option B — "Timebox Stretch" (pure extension)
- 3-week extension to the pilot, same access and support level.
- Price: $25,000 (one-off invoice) OR $22,500 if SlimLine signs the attached LOI (2-week procurement window) committing to an evaluation-to-purchase conversation.

Operational notes / tradeoffs
- Mezzanine Credit is cheaper up front and keeps procurement simple (line item = credit purchase). Its preferred if you want flexible usage and easier PO processing.
- Timebox Stretch gives predictable calendar time for integration and engineering ramp but is a larger up-front spend.

Next steps I propose: you pick A or B and well (1) attach a one-page SOW addendum, (2) Ben will confirm final discount authority, and (3) finance will issue an invoice for PO processing. I attached a draft SOW and a brief usage CSV so you can see the expected burn profile.

If youd like a small concession to help close today we can offer a 10% promotional discount on Option A if you approve before COB tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
